import re

async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to the merge requests page for the a11yproject/a11yproject.com project
    # Use the heading to scope the link with name '3' to avoid multiple matches
    merge_requests_link = page.get_by_role("heading", name="The A11Y Project / a11yproject.com", level=2).get_by_role("link", name="3", exact=True)
    await merge_requests_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: Find the merge request related to focus edge cases
    # Filter merge request links for text containing 'focus' (case-insensitive)
    merge_request_links = page.get_by_role("link").filter(has_text=re.compile(r'focus', re.IGNORECASE))
    count = await merge_request_links.count()
    if count == 0:
        # If no merge request with 'focus' in text, assume the first merge request is the target
        # Look for links that start with '!' which is common for merge request indicators in GitLab
        first_mr_link = page.get_by_role("link").filter(has_text=re.compile(r'^!', re.IGNORECASE))
        await first_mr_link.first.click()
    else:
        await merge_request_links.first.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Post the comment 'close because non reproducible'
    comment_textarea = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Comment")
    await comment_textarea.fill("close because non reproducible")
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Comment")
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
